name: Shader fill — Syntax gradient panel
description: Procedural three-colour metaball gradient panel in the Syntax palette: yellow (#fabf47), teal (#00fff5), green (#beff00). The WGSL shader fills a 60%×28% centred rect in canvas UV space; alpha blends at 0.88 opacity without punching through the frame (E4 contract). Flow speed 0.8 keeps motion subtle — the gradient breathes rather than churns. Transparent by default; composites over footage or a dark substrate. Demonstrates the overlay shaderPass path end-to-end.
